outcome: Maternal morbidities (induction of labor, Cesarean section, premature rupture of membranes)
cohort: The study included 280 pregnant women, divided into 140 cases with gestational diabetes mellitus and 140 age-matched non-diabetic controls.
finding: Maternal morbidities and neonatal complications such as neonatal hypoglycemia, macrosomia, and prematurity were significantly higher in women with GDM compared to non-diabetic women.
mod_finding: The frequency of induction of labor was significantly higher in GDM mothers, and Cesarean section rates were 40.1% for GDM mothers and 35.8% for non-diabetic mothers.
birth_weight: Macrosomia was observed in babies of diabetic mothers.
gest_age: Prematurity was observed in babies of diabetic mothers.
